PP_CalIntro: If a stick moves on its own (drift) or does not reach the edge, this wizard measures and fixes it. The calibration is saved on each controller and applied in every game and profile.
PP_CalNoControllerText: Turn on a controller to calibrate it.
PP_CalNotSaved: This controller has no calibration yet.
PP_CalSavedInfo: Saved calibration ({0}): dead zone left {1} %, right {2} % (anti-drift on).
PP_CalIdleText: It takes about 10 seconds: first leave the sticks alone, then turn them in full circles.
PP_CalStep1Title: Step 1 of 2: don't touch the sticks
PP_CalStep1Text: Leave the controller on the table or let go of both sticks. Measuring how much they move on their own...
PP_CalStep2Title: Step 2 of 2: turn both sticks in circles
PP_CalStep2Text: Push them to the edge and turn them slowly in full circles, both sticks at the same time.
PP_CalDoneText: Check it and press Save to use it in every game.
PP_CalResultStick: {0}: moved on its own {1} % → anti-drift dead zone {2} %.
PP_CalReachNotMeasured: Reach: not measured (turn the stick in full circles to measure it).
PP_CalReachShort: Reach: only reaches {0} % → full output from there.
PP_CalSavedText: It is applied now in every game and profile for this controller.
PP_CalLegend: In the drawing: the dot is the live stick position, the purple circle is the dead zone (inside it the game gets no movement) and the dotted line is the reach (full output from there).
